test.title: A heating problem in a rented flat

document.lead: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
after: You do NOT need to write any addresses.

text: I am writing to let you know about a problem with the heating in the flat at 22 Beech Court, which I have been renting from you since last September.

For the past week, the boiler has been switching itself off several times a day, and on two occasions it would not start again until the following morning. As a result, the flat has been extremely cold, and we have had to rely on a small electric heater, which is expensive to run.
This is particularly difficult at the moment because my wife works from home and our baby is only four months old. We are worried that the problem will get worse as the weather becomes colder.

I would be grateful if you could arrange for an engineer to inspect the boiler as soon as possible. I work from home on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so either of those days would be convenient, but I could also leave a key with our neighbour if another day suits the engineer better.
Thank you in advance for your help.

note.en: Sets how long the problem has lasted.
note.kk: Мәселенің қанша уақыттан бері бар екенін көрсетеді.

note.en: Highlights why it is especially hard now.
note.kk: Неге қазір әсіресе қиын екенін бөліп көрсетеді.

note.en: A consequence: at home on Tuesdays and Thursdays, so those days suit.
note.kk: Салдары: сейсенбі мен бейсенбі үйде — бұл күндер ыңғайлы.
note.ru: Следствие: дома по вторникам и четвергам — эти дни удобны.

strengths.en: “Has been switching itself off” shows a problem that started earlier and is still going on.
strengths.kk: «has been switching itself off», «has been extremely cold» — мәселе бұрын басталып, әлі жалғасуда.
strengths.ru: «has been switching itself off», «has been extremely cold» — проблема началась раньше и продолжается.
strengths.example: the boiler has been switching itself off several times a day

strengths.en: A small baby and working from home make the urgency clear.
strengths.kk: Кішкентай бала және үйден жұмыс — неге шұғыл екені түсінікті.
strengths.ru: Маленький ребёнок и работа из дома — понятно, почему нужно срочно.
strengths.example: our baby is only four months old

strengths.en: The writer offers days at once and a back-up plan with a key.
strengths.kk: Жазушы бірден күндерді және кілтпен қосалқы нұсқаны ұсынады.
strengths.ru: Пишущий сразу предлагает дни и запасной вариант с ключом.
strengths.example: I could also leave a key with our neighbour

strengths.en: “I would be grateful … as soon as possible” is polite but makes the urgency clear.
strengths.kk: «I would be grateful … as soon as possible» — сыпайы, бірақ шұғыл екені анық.
strengths.ru: «I would be grateful … as soon as possible» — вежливо, но ясно, что срочно.
strengths.example: arrange for an engineer to inspect the boiler as soon as possible

note.en: The landlord is known, so the opening uses his surname: semi-formal.
note.ru: Хозяин квартиры знаком — по фамилии, semi-formal.

note.en: The problem, the address and how long the writer has rented: all the landlord needs.
note.kk: Мәселе, мекенжай және қанша уақыт жалдап тұр — иесіне керектің бәрі.
note.ru: Проблема, адрес и сколько снимает — всё, что нужно хозяину.

note.en: Bullet 1: exactly what is wrong and the consequences.
note.ru: Пункт 1 — что именно не работает и последствия.

note.en: Bullet 2: why it is especially difficult now — a baby, working from home.
note.kk: 2-тармақ — неге қазір әсіресе қиын: бала, үйден жұмыс.
note.ru: Пункт 2 — почему это особенно трудно сейчас: ребёнок, работа из дома.

note.en: Bullet 3: the request and convenient options for the engineer’s visit.
note.kk: 3-тармақ — өтініш және шебердің келуіне ыңғайлы нұсқалар.
note.ru: Пункт 3 — просьба и удобные варианты для визита мастера.

note.en: A name in the opening means “Yours sincerely”.

document.title: A heating problem in a rented flat
bullets: explain why it is causing difficulties for you
say what you would like the landlord to do
